proposition: In the R. Shaqq-i Qamar Ibn Turka assigns the illuminationists (the 'ancient philosophers') to level four; on Q 54:1 they also deny the sensory moon can be split and read the moon as the light intermixed with bodily darkness, whose splitting is the manifestation of all its potential knowledge, again peculiar to the Prophet.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
